lines.speaker: narration
lines.text: The party travels through the portal,

lines.speaker: narration
lines.text: and finds themselves in a village completely frozen over by the Winter's Bane.

lines.speaker: narration
lines.text: It clearly illustrates that they are one step closer to the White Ice Dragon in the Demon King's castle,

lines.speaker: narration
lines.text: and that the end of the story is drawing near.

lines.speaker: maiden_w
lines.text: A world where everything is frozen...

lines.speaker: maiden_w
lines.text: What a desolate place.

lines.speaker: guillotine_w
lines.text: ... Painfully so.

lines.speaker: maiden_w
lines.text: Huh? Do you see that over there?

lines.speaker: maiden_w
lines.text: Is that some kind of light?
Let's check it out.

lines.speaker: narration
lines.text: The party eventually reaches a place with a bonfire.

lines.speaker: narration
lines.text: Or more precisely, a rifle which has been propped in the ground is belching fire from the barrel.

lines.speaker: narration
lines.text: Beside the "fire" is Exia, sitting in a plastic chair.

lines.speaker: maiden_w
lines.text: Exia?

lines.speaker: guillotine_w
lines.text: Hmph. I thought you'd gone into hiding after our first meeting. So this is where you've been.

lines.speaker: exia_c
lines.text: Ah, so it's you.

lines.speaker: exia_c
lines.text: El Telema Solus.

lines.speaker: exia_c
lines.text: So you've come to this place for the White Ice Dragon.

lines.speaker: guillotine_w
lines.text: Take a look at this, Exia!

lines.speaker: guillotine_w
lines.text: These are my companions.

lines.speaker: guillotine_w
lines.text: Contrary to what you said, I am not without companions!

lines.speaker: exia_c
lines.text: Unfortunately for you.

lines.speaker: exia_c
lines.text: Utterly bereft of companions.

lines.speaker: exia_c
lines.text: You are fated to die in loneliness.

lines.speaker: guillotine_w
lines.text: You're still blabbering about that?

lines.speaker: maiden_w
lines.text: This is a world based on Guillotine's NIMPH,

lines.speaker: maiden_w
lines.text: so that's not Exia.

lines.speaker: maiden_w
lines.text: At least not the Exia I know...

lines.speaker: maiden_w
lines.text: Whew...

lines.speaker: maiden_w
lines.text: All right, Exia.

lines.speaker: maiden_w
lines.text: First things first.

lines.speaker: maiden_w
lines.text: If we sit by the bonfire, will you enhance our stats?

lines.speaker: exia_c
lines.text: Go.

lines.speaker: exia_c
lines.text: Go to the icebound Demon King's castle, where the source of this Winter's Bane resides.

lines.speaker: exia_c
lines.text: If you wish to be a hero, this is what you must do. Even if you have no companions.

lines.speaker: maiden_w
lines.text: Exia?

lines.speaker: exia_c
lines.text: Ah, so it's you.

lines.speaker: exia_c
lines.text: El Telema Solus.

lines.speaker: maiden_w
lines.text: Ugh... is this just another NPC that repeats the same few lines?

lines.speaker: maiden_w
lines.text: Let's ignore her and move along.

lines.speaker: guillotine_w
lines.text: Before that... may I offer a suggestion?
What is it?

lines.speaker: guillotine_w
lines.text: Before we head into the Demon King's Castle,

lines.speaker: guillotine_w
lines.text: we should at least discuss a method to defeat the White Ice Dragon.

lines.speaker: guillotine_w
lines.text: Don't you think?

lines.speaker: maiden_w
lines.text: Wow. You're learning.

lines.speaker: maiden_w
lines.text: Well, since our goal is a flawless no-death run,

lines.speaker: maiden_w
lines.text: it's only right that we discuss how to defeat the White Ice Dragon in advance.

lines.speaker: maiden_w
lines.text: We'll also need to figure out a few safety measures,

lines.speaker: maiden_w
lines.text: since we need to finish the raid without anyone bowing out prematurely.

lines.speaker: guillotine_w
lines.text: Hehe, the battle hasn't even begun and I can feel my blood starting to boil.

lines.speaker: guillotine_w
lines.text: So Maiden, what should I do?

lines.speaker: maiden_w
lines.text: What you need to do is simple.

lines.speaker: maiden_w
lines.text: Just don't use the Lethal Eye.

lines.speaker: guillotine_w
lines.text: ... What?

lines.speaker: maiden_w
lines.text: Do you remember what happened both times after you've used it recently?

lines.speaker: guillotine_w
lines.text: How could I forget? Every time after I've used it, I wake up in the inn.

lines.speaker: guillotine_w
lines.text: ... Hold on.

lines.speaker: guillotine_w
lines.text: Don't tell me...

lines.speaker: maiden_w
lines.text: That's right.
Maiden explains what happened to Guillotine both times after using the Lethal Eye.

lines.speaker: guillotine_w
lines.text: So that's what's been going on.

lines.speaker: guillotine_w
lines.text: In the past, I sealed the One-Winged Dark Lord away in my right eye.

lines.speaker: guillotine_w
lines.text: Afterwards, I have used its power to defeat evil,

lines.speaker: guillotine_w
lines.text: but without breaking the seal entirely.

lines.speaker: guillotine_w
lines.text: Every time I have unleashed that power, I have felt it.

lines.speaker: guillotine_w
lines.text: I have felt the One-Winged Dark Lord biding its time, waiting for a moment of weakness from me.

lines.speaker: guillotine_w
lines.text: Waiting for the day when the seal is broken to take control of my body!

lines.speaker: guillotine_w
lines.text: No wonder I felt the power in my eye become stronger since coming to this world.

lines.speaker: guillotine_w
lines.text: It was all the work of the One-Winged Dark Lord.

lines.speaker: maiden_w
lines.text: So...

lines.speaker: maiden_w
lines.text: If you keep using the Lethal Eye, the seal may end up breaking?

lines.speaker: guillotine_w
lines.text: You pick things up quickly, Ice Rose. As expected of you.

lines.speaker: guillotine_w
lines.text: Indeed, if I unleash the full power contained within this eye of mine, the seal will be broken,

lines.speaker: guillotine_w
lines.text: and the One-Winged Dark Lord will take over my body.

lines.speaker: maiden_w
lines.text: *Sigh*...

lines.speaker: maiden_w
lines.text: You fabricating wild stories like that is why all this happened in the first place.

lines.speaker: maiden_w
lines.text: I'm so tired...
Guillotine, can you tell us more about the One-Winged Dark Lord?

lines.speaker: guillotine_w
lines.text: Oh no!

lines.speaker: guillotine_w
lines.text: Now you are interested in the One-Winged Dark Lord as well, Partner?

lines.speaker: guillotine_w
lines.text: It seeks to create a world ruled by silence.

lines.speaker: guillotine_w
lines.text: It is an evil entity,

lines.speaker: guillotine_w
lines.text: and it will eliminate anything that stands in its way.
So that's why it attacked us.

lines.speaker: maiden_w
lines.text: All the more reason not to use your eye.

lines.speaker: maiden_w
lines.text: What do you plan to do if the One-Winged Dark Lord assumes complete control?

lines.speaker: maiden_w
lines.text: You're a member of Extrinsic as well, Guillotine.

lines.speaker: maiden_w
lines.text: When we say that our targets are Irregulars,

lines.speaker: maiden_w
lines.text: that doesn't refer only to corrupted Nikkes,

lines.speaker: maiden_w
lines.text: but to any and all Nikkes that pose a threat to the Ark,

lines.speaker: maiden_w
lines.text: and it's safe to say that the One-Winged Dark Lord could be considered such a threat...

lines.speaker: guillotine_w
lines.text: So, if the demon does indeed possess me completely, I must ask of you.

lines.speaker: guillotine_w
lines.text: To ensure that the world does not fall into chaos,

lines.speaker: guillotine_w
lines.text: you must carry out your duty, Maiden.

lines.speaker: guillotine_w
lines.text: If I am consumed by the One-Winged Dark Lord, and I become an Irregular,

lines.speaker: guillotine_w
lines.text: you must eliminate me, and become a hero of the Ark.

lines.speaker: maiden_w
lines.text: A hero of the Ark...

lines.speaker: maiden_w
lines.text: And what about me?

lines.speaker: maiden_w
lines.text: What if I become an Irregular?

lines.speaker: maiden_w
lines.text: Would you do what has to be done, Guillotine?

lines.speaker: guillotine_w
lines.text: Of course I would.

lines.speaker: guillotine_w
lines.text: All Extrinsic members must distinguish between professional and personal affairs.

lines.speaker: guillotine_w
lines.text: I must keep my composure and do what must be done for the sake of the Ark.

lines.speaker: guillotine_w
lines.text: I will follow the orders that are given to me.

lines.speaker: maiden_w
lines.text: I see...

lines.speaker: guillotine_w
lines.text: However.

lines.speaker: guillotine_w
lines.text: You will not become an Irregular.

lines.speaker: maiden_w
lines.text: No one can say that for sure.

lines.speaker: guillotine_w
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: guillotine_w
lines.text: I'll make sure that it doesn't happen.

lines.speaker: guillotine_w
lines.text: Even if I have to sacrifice this body.

lines.speaker: guillotine_w
lines.text: I will make sure you never become an Irregular.

lines.speaker: guillotine_w
lines.text: Maiden.

lines.speaker: guillotine_w
lines.text: You will not become an Irregular.

lines.speaker: maiden_w
lines.text: ... Guillotine,

lines.speaker: maiden_w
lines.text: why are you always willing to do so much for me?

lines.speaker: unknown
lines.text: Awww, it's almost enough to get you wet around the eyeballs.

lines.speaker: unknown
lines.text: Rust buckets these days, they'll say just about anything apparently.
Syuen?!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: You better watch out!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: How does filth like you dare to look at me in the eye!? Syuen, of the Four Heavenly Kings.

lines.speaker: maiden_w
lines.text: Of all the times to run into one of these guys...

lines.speaker: maiden_w
lines.text: We don't have time for this.

lines.speaker: maiden_w
lines.text: If this keeps up, Guillotine will...

lines.speaker: narration
lines.text: The armored knight draws his giant sword and slams it into the ground,

lines.speaker: narration
lines.text: sending ice shards scattering everywhere.

lines.speaker: narration
lines.text: At the same time, a towering wall of ice forms between the armored knight and the rest of the team members.

lines.speaker: maiden_w
lines.text: Commander...?
You said it yourself, Maiden.
Guillotine hasn't become an Irregular yet,
so let's take down the final boss together.

lines.speaker: maiden_w
lines.text: But...
I trust your judgment.
I'll handle things over here. You go and take down the White Ice Dragon.
And then we'll all return together.

lines.speaker: maiden_w
lines.text: ... All right. I won't let you down.
We're not going back without you, Maiden.

lines.speaker: maiden_w
lines.text: Let's go, Guillotine.
Maiden and Guillotine's footsteps fade into the distance.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Are you sure about this?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: It seems you're feeling awfully cocky after facing Mustang,

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: but he was the weakest amongst us.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Unlike him, my power level is over 9000!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: No, wait, I mean 530,000!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Do you really think you can take me on by yourself?
I couldn't care less about power levels.
It's not every day that I get to use the lessons that I learned from you.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Huh? What have I taught you?
To hammer down the nail
that doesn't know its place.
System: {AccountData.NickName} has left the party.
